skins.label: Paperback Playback
skins.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a premium richly painted SQUARE illustration ATLAS for an existing Colt Radio music-player skin. This is background and equine mascot ARTWORK ONLY, not a finished UI screenshot. THREE horizontal regions with straight crisp boundaries: TOP y=0–33% is a beautifully detailed wide scenic header, no horse or people anywhere in this region; decorative objects and instruments at far left/right, a dark uncluttered CENTRAL title space. MIDDLE y=33–53% is a blank dark themed material panel, central x=7–93% uncluttered texture, narrow decorative rails only at far x=0–7% and93–100%. BOTTOM y=53–100% exactly ONE friendly horse head-and-shoulders portrait, centered x=50%, shoulders to bottom, full ears/mane/hat visible with breathing room, character occupies x=22–78%, top of ears below y=55%. The Colt has a familiar RIGHT-FACING THREE-QUARTER equine HEAD POSE while its visible eyes gently look TOWARD THE VIEWER/camera. Maintain a long natural HORSE MUZZLE and proper horse skull, NOT straight-on frontal, NOT a human-faced animal. Warm friendly expression, natural equine ears and mane, no human hands. Premium cozy game-interface painting with tactile materials, coherent cinematic warm/cool lighting and a readable small portrait. No text, numbers, lettering, watermarks, logos, music-note symbols, station cards, labels, baked buttons or UI. Only one horse and it is in the bottom region, no extra animals. THEME PAPERBACK PLAYBACK: quiet BOOKSHOP music-listening corner. TOP: tall dark walnut shelves full of beautifully worn unlettered cloth-bound books, antique brass reading lamps, forest-green upholstered reading chair at far LEFT, and a beautiful small walnut record player with vinyl record and brass tonearm at far RIGHT; a little open book with blank pages at edge. A tall rain-speckled window and gentle amber light; central title area dark green/dark wood and clear. Book spines must be entirely unlettered. MIDDLE: deep FOREST-GREEN linen bookbinding cloth with narrow WALNUT rails, antique brass corner protectors and fine bookmark-ribbon details only at outer rails. BOTTOM: handsome friendly DAPPLE CHARCOAL-GRAY horse with a soft warm-gray muzzle, small natural ivory forehead star, softly swept SILVER-white mane, thin round antique-brass reading glasses correctly fitted on equine face. Oatmeal knit cardigan over a cream shirt with a modest forest-green collar. No headphones, no hat, no human beard. Calm thoughtful warm brown eyes meeting the viewer in the familiar angled horse pose, gentle closed-mouth equine smile. Background dark forest green. Palette forest green, antique brass, ivory pages and walnut. Cozy analog reading/music personality.
